Definition: from the same as G1384; test (abstractly or concretely); by implication, trustiness:--experience(-riment), proof, trial.
BiblicalUsage: Proof, experience, the trustworthiness that comes out of testing, the character a person shows when tried. Paul knew the proof of the Corinthians' obedience, and Timothy's proof as a son with his father in the gospel. Patience works experience, and the churches of Macedonia showed the proof of their joy in deep poverty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe experience is what patience produces, and patience is what suffering produces when I do not quit. The proof of a life is not what I claim in the easy days but what the trial reveals.
